verdict.rationale: Langfuse is an LLM engineering platform with an LLM Playground and LLM-as-a-judge evaluators, so letting users plug in MCP servers as tool sources is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence shows only that Langfuse publishes its own MCP server for other AI tools to connect to, which is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Langfuse consuming external MCP servers or their tools.
